title: Paint House
statement: `costs[i]` is the cost of painting house i red, blue, or green, in that order. Adjacent houses cannot share a color. Return the minimum cost to paint every house.
hints: The state is the house and the color you just used.
Painting house i color c costs costs[i][c] plus the cheaper of the other two colors on house i - 1.

approaches.name: Recursion
approaches.explanation: Two legal colors after the first.

editorial: Keep the minimum cost of reaching the current house in each color. The next red cost is the red paint plus the min of the previous blue and green. The answer is the min of the three totals after the last house.
